definition: A pure symmetric N-qubit state is t-anticoherent iff rho_t is the maximally mixed state I_(t+1)/(t+1) on the symmetric t-qubit subspace. Equivalently all spin moments through order t are independent of direction. This requires every multipole rank1,...,t to vanish, not only the even ranks.

sourceCaveats.issue: The printed q=3 label conflicts with both the listed nonzero rank3 multipole and the explicit state. The normalized printed state has achieved order2, not3: rho_3[0,3]=(10-sqrt(42))/126 is nonzero.
Printed endpoint amplitudes1/sqrt(11) with middle amplitude sqrt(3/5) have norm squared43/55. Use the normalized exact construction from PRA92(2015) Eq48; do not silently quote the erroneous row.
